blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two ranking House of Representatives lawmakers have called out Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers for their demeanor during the impeachment trial, saying that the counsel on duty on Monday was rude, while the one deployed on Tuesday was evasive. In a press briefing on Tuesday, Deputy Speaker Paolo Ortega V and Manila Rep. Bienvenido Abante Jr. were both asked if they have observed differences in how defense lawyers cross-examined former Sandiganbayan presiding justice Amparo Cabotaje-Tang on Monday, and earlier, Office of the Ombudsman Central Records Division officer-in-charge Atty.
